findings.summary: New page creation uses a constant sibling slug, so the tree create path fails after the first new page.
findings.details: The implemented adapter always submits siblingSlug "untitled-page" for every New page action. The backend rejects duplicate active sibling slugs under the same parent with PageTreeConflict, so a normal second root-page creation from the required tree UI path fails instead of creating another page. The focused web tests only assert the button/refs and snapshot save behavior; they do not exercise repeated create args against the page schema/backend conflict rule.

findings.summary: The page tree rename control cannot produce a renamed title.
findings.details: The required tree rename path is wired to call onRenamePage with page.title, the current title, and there is no input, dialog, or draft state that lets an editor provide a different title. Pressing Rename therefore submits a no-op rename revision rather than the user-selected new page name, while the focused test only checks that the Rename affordance is present.
